scope: Generator runs isolated to /tmp against WORKSPACE sources; no repository output written.
conclusion: The projection is reproducible when source=todo and current live micelio responds; snapshot mode is a materially different source and must not be substituted silently.

findings.statement: fuente is not metadata-only: it changes the projection by hundreds of pieces/links.
todo reproduces payload exactly but output hash changes because generated timestamp changes.

recommendations.action: Record source option and input hashes; treat source changes as an explicit versioned projection change.
For deterministic comparisons, separate generated_at from canonical payload hash or record both.
Pin/attest whether publication may use live micelio or snapshot fallback; require a visible fallback status.
